QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_70

question.text: Ms. Lakshmi Narayanan is negotiating with an anchor LP who demands 'no catch-up'. As GP, what is the BEST counter-proposal to preserve economics while accommodating the LP?

answer.text: Propose a 50% catch-up with a stepped-up carry rate (e.g., 25%) above the catch-up
Switch to a higher management fee instead

explanation.text: The Logic: A balanced compromise: 50% catch-up (instead of 100%) with a slightly higher carry rate (e.g., 25% vs 20%) above the catch-up point. Approximates the GP's original expected catch-up economics while giving LP the 'slower catch-up' optics they want. The Trap: Option B eliminates a key LP protection. Option A gives away GP economics. Option D misaligns incentives toward mgmt fee rather than carry. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A/B for hurdle/catch-up negotiation; XXI-B for PMS structural parallels. Manager's Pro-Tip: Always model at least 3 scenarios in negotiations: (1) GP opening, (2) LP opening, (3) compromise. Bring IRR sensitivities to GP carry so economics are visible. LPAC approval on any mid-fund renegotiation is essential — don't rely on bilateral side letters.
